tasks.label: ROS: test workspace
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && colcon test && colcon test-result --verbose'

tasks.label: ROS: launch perception + terrain safety
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch quadruped_bringup bringup.launch.py'

tasks.label: ROS: launch SLAM + Nav2 + perception
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch slam slam.launch.py'

tasks.label: ROS: launch independent autonomous navigation
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch slam autonomous_navigation.launch.py'

tasks.label: ROS: launch standalone Gazebo field and sensors
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch quadruped_gazebo robocon_field.launch.py'
